mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.uuid, a.business_type AS businessType, a.business_uuid AS businessUuid, a.file_name AS fileName, a.original_file_name AS originalFileName, a.file_ext AS fileExt, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.storage_path AS storagePath, a.uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, u.real_name AS uploadedByName, u.username AS uploadedByUsername, a.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.uploaded_by WHERE a.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT a.id, a.uuid, a.business_type AS businessType, a.business_uuid AS businessUuid, a.file_name AS fileName, a.original_file_name AS originalFileName, a.file_ext AS fileExt, a.mime_type AS mimeType, a.file_size AS fileSize, a.storage_path AS storagePath, a.uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, u.real_name AS uploadedByName, u.username AS uploadedByUsername, a.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.uploaded_by ORDER BY a.uploaded_at DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment ( uuid, business_type, business_uuid, file_name, original_file_name, file_ext, mime_type, file_size, storage_path, uploaded_by, uploaded_at ) VALUES ( #{uuid}, #{businessType}, #{businessUuid}, #{fileName}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileExt}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{uploadedBy}, NOW() )
